decision: Reject both candidates for production; restore fixed224 starting implementation. Keep reproducible experimental patches.
scope: Local EP8 only. GIN/network code keeps baseline path; no multi-node performance claim.

algorithm.baseline: During dgrad, convert saved row FP8 X in place once and save dY in column FP8. All dW tiles reuse these globally stored column operands.
algorithm.candidate: Keep saved X row FP8; save dY row FP8. dW TMA loads row operands into shared scratch. Convert next K128 operand into the next shared WGMMA stage while current K128 MMA is in flight. No global column X/dY cache write. H and dZ remain directly column-quantized from BF16 in SwiGLU.
algorithm.numerics: Actual per-column amax, pow2 scales, E4M3 RN, K128 FP32 promotion, BF16 dW; existing AB/Z path unchanged.
algorithm.memory: Removes one global X read and one global X write during dgrad. dY global bytes unchanged. dW input read bytes unchanged, but conversion repeats per tile. Global allocation size unchanged. Extra shared scratch is reserved, not a separate global buffer.

variants.fused: 4 packed BF16 pairs per lane, warp-wide reduction, 16 channels per conversion iteration.
variants.wide: 16 packed BF16 pairs per lane, 8-lane reduction, 64 channels per conversion iteration. Fewer iterations but more static spill.

method: Unprofiled per-step slowest-rank wall median, 10 warmups + 30 samples after 40 full priming steps. Variable per-rank token counts around 8192/20480, identical random input/routing hashes. Source FP8 communication, BF16 dW. Weight preparation excluded. No compilation, disassembly or profiler overlaps performance runs. BWD-only prepares a fresh FWD tape outside timing; cycle includes FWD+BWD. These are not pure kernel timings.
